name: Soviet DShK 12.7mm Ammunition Box
description: Galvanized-steel transport container for 85 rounds of 12.7×108mm ammunition, with olive drab paint, brass latches, and leather carrying straps.
needs: Exact dimensions (W×H×D) from museum catalog or GOST standard — TA072 scale model kit lacks metric specs

parts.name: Main galvanized steel box
parts.src: TA072 scale model kit (Tank Model), Soviet 12.7mm DShK ammunition box proportions
parts.derivation: 85-round capacity in alternating rows; scale inferred from round count (12.7×108mm ≈130mm length)

parts.name: Hinged steel lid with lever lock
parts.src: TA072 scale model kit; Soviet lever-lock mechanism standard
parts.note: Lid overlaps body edges slightly; lever latch detail omitted (voxel limitation)

parts.name: Flat-folding steel handle (closed position)
parts.src: Soviet ammunition box standard design (Шпагин feed system documentation)
parts.note: Modeled in closed/stowed position lying flat on the lid

parts.name: Brass latch (left side)
parts.src: TA072 scale model kit; Soviet bronze/brass hardware standard finish

parts.name: Leather carrying strap (top)
parts.src: Soviet ammunition container field equipment standard (Военная энциклопедия)

parts.name: Stenciled identification (left face)
parts.src: Decoding Soviet Military Surplus Ammunition Labels (DCAF CAR research)
parts.note: Cyrillic lot/factory/year stencils; simplified as flat decal in voxel model

parts.name: Red star (center front)
parts.src: Soviet state insignia standard (ГОСТ) on all military ordnance containers
parts.note: Embossed/painted red star; voxel simplified as flat marking
